## Set Up Workspace

```{r,  warning=F, message=F}
# Load packages and functions
source("../RMDFiles/Load Packages and Functions.R")

# Load uncoded data
Study1A <- read_csv("Study1A_Data.csv") %>% mutate(study = "Study 1A")
Study1B <- read_csv("Study1B_Data.csv") %>% mutate(study = "Study 1B")

# Restructure Data
Study1A.vert <- Study1A %>% 
  gather(key = variable, value = value, -ID, -study, -Age, -Gender, -English,
         -Start.T1, -Start.T2, -all.monetary) %>%
  separate(variable, c("variable", "gift"), sep="_") %>%
  spread(variable, value)

Study1B.vert <- Study1B %>% 
  gather(key = variable, value = value, -ID, -study, -Age, -Gender, -English,
         -Start.T1, -Start.T2, -all.monetary) %>%
  separate(variable, c("variable", "gift"), sep="_") %>%
  spread(variable, value) %>% 
  mutate(moneyT2 = 1) #Identifying all gifts as non-monetary

# Combine Datasets
gifts <- rbind(Study1A.vert, Study1B.vert)

# Compute variables
## Attitude Change
gifts <- mutate(gifts, change = abs(EvalT1 - EvalT2))

## Perceived Stability
gifts <- gifts %>% mutate(pstab1T1 = as.numeric(pstab1T1), 
                          pstab2T1 = as.numeric(pstab2T1), 
                          pstab3T1 = as.numeric(pstab3T1),
                          pstab2T1r = 6 - pstab2T1,
                          pstabT1 = (pstab1T1 + pstab2T1r + pstab3T1) / 3)


## Time 1 Valence
gifts <- gifts %>% 
  mutate(valence = factor(ifelse(EvalT1 > 4.5, "Positive" ,"Negative")),
         valence.eff = (as.numeric(valence) - 1.5)*2, #Effects coding (-1: Neg, +1: Pos)
         valenceNeg = (valence.eff + 1)/2, #Dummy code with Neg as reference (0: Neg, 1: Pos)
         valencePos = ((valence.eff * -1) + 1)/2) #Dummy code with Pos as reference (0: Pos, 1: Neg)

## Valence Switching
gifts <- gifts %>% 
  mutate(ValSwitch = ifelse(EvalT1 < 4.5 & EvalT2 > 4.5, 1,
                            ifelse(EvalT1 > 4.5 & EvalT2 < 4.5, 1, -1)))

# Reformat Dates
gifts <- separate(gifts, Start.T1, c("StartDate.T1", "StartTime.T1"), sep=" ") %>% 
  mutate(StartDate.T1 = as.Date(StartDate.T1, "%m/%d/%Y"))
gifts <- separate(gifts, Start.T2, c("StartDate.T2", "StartTime.T2"), sep=" ") %>% 
  mutate(StartDate.T2 = as.Date(StartDate.T2, "%m/%d/%Y"))
gifts <- gifts %>% mutate(delay = StartDate.T2 - StartDate.T1)

# Code for retention
gifts <- gifts %>% mutate(retention = ifelse(is.na(EvalT2) == F, 1, 0))

# Drop Giftcard Observations
## In Study 1A, we didn't think to direct people away from listing 
## giftcards at T1, so we asked at T2 to report whether a given gift 
## was money/giftcard. We drop these observations in the final analyses.
giftcard.table <- Study1A.vert %>% 
  mutate(giftcard = factor(moneyT2, 
                           labels = c("Not Money/Gift Card", 
                                      "Money/Gift Card"))) %>% 
  filter(all.monetary == 0) %$% #These two said all three were monetary
  table(giftcard) #Save breakdown of number of gifts marked "money/gift card")

gifts.full <- gifts #Save the unreduced dataset as "gifts.full"
gifts <- filter(gifts.full, moneyT2 != "2" | is.na(moneyT2) == T) #Save gifts as the reduced dataset

## Getting person-level means
gifts <- gifts %>% group_by(ID) %>% 
  mutate(m_EmotT1 = mean(EmotT1, na.rm = T),
         m_ExtT1 = mean(ExtT1, na.rm = T),
         m_valence.eff = mean(valence.eff, na.rm = T),
         m_pstabT1 = mean(pstabT1, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup()

```

<br>

## Guide to Selected Variable Names

* EmotT1: The emotionality of the adjective selected as the best word to describe one's attitude (Time 1).
* ExtT1: The extremity of the adjective selected as the best word to describe one's attitude (Time 1). 
* valence.eff: Effects coded dichotomous valence of the attitude (-1 = Negative; +1 = Positive) 
* ValSwitch: Whether or not the attitude changed valence from Time 1 to Time 2 (effects coded)
* pstabT1: How much someone thought their attitude would change in the future (averaged across 3 items)
* change: Absolute difference in EvalT1 and EvalT2
* EvalT1: The overall evaluation implied by the adjective selected as the best word to desribe one's attitude (Time 1) 
* EvalT2: The overall evaluation implied by the adjective selected as the best word to desribe one's attitude (Time 2) 

<br>

### Predicting Retention

```{r}
gifts.retention <- gifts %>% 
  select(ID, m_valence.eff, m_ExtT1, m_EmotT1, retention) %>% 
  unique()
glm(retention ~ m_valence.eff + m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1, 
      data = gifts.retention, family = "binomial") %>% 
  display.glm(OR = T) %>% htable()

```

<br>

Quantifying Outlier Status of Valence Switching:

```{r}
## Standard Deviation (Z score) approach
change.mean.noswitch <- filter(gifts, ValSwitch == -1) %>% 
  summarize(mean.change = mean(change), sd.change = sd(change))
change.mean.switch <- filter(gifts, ValSwitch == 1) %>% 
  summarize(mean.change = mean(change), sd.change = sd(change))
SD.outlier <- (change.mean.switch$mean.change - 
                 change.mean.noswitch$mean.change) / 
  change.mean.noswitch$sd.change #Average SDs from the mean on non-valence switching cases.
```

On average, attitudes that switched valence had an absolute attitude change of `r round(change.mean.switch$mean.change, 2)` (*SD* = `r round(change.mean.switch$sd.change, 2)`). This is **`r round(SD.outlier, 2)` standard deviations** from the mean absolute attitude change of attitudes that did not switch valence (*M* = `r round(change.mean.noswitch$mean.change, 2)`, *SD* = `r round(change.mean.noswitch$sd.change, 2)`)

## Results

### Total Observations

**Time 1**

Number of observations: `nrow(gifts)` = `r nrow(gifts)`

Number of unique participants: `length(unique(gifts$ID))` = `r length(unique(gifts$ID))`

<br>

**Time 2**

Number of observations: `sum(!is.na(gifts$EvalT2))` = `r sum(!is.na(gifts$EvalT2))`

Number of unique participants:

```{r}
filter(gifts, !is.na(EvalT2)) %>% select(ID) %>% 
  unique() %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% pull()
```

<br>

### Attitude Change

(For simplicity, this report only outputs fixed effects unless there's a specific reason to report more.)

**Overall Effects (Model 1)**

```{r}
lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + 
       (1|ID), data = gifts)  %>% display.lmer(digits = 3) %>% htable()
```

<br>

**Valence Interactions (Model 2)**

```{r}
lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + valence.eff * ExtT1 + valence.eff * EmotT1 + m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 +
       (1|ID), data = gifts) %>% display.lmer() %>% htable()
```

<br>

**Adding Gift as a Random Effect**

```{r, warning = F}
model.nogift <- lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + valence.eff * ExtT1 + valence.eff * EmotT1 + 
                       m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), data = gifts)
model.gift <- lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + valence.eff * ExtT1 + valence.eff * EmotT1 + 
                     m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID) + (1|gift), data = gifts)
anova(model.nogift, model.gift) %>% tidy() %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 2) %>% htable()
```

<br>

### Predicted Attitude Change

**Accuracy of Predicted Attitude Change**

```{r}
lmer(change ~ pstabT1 + m_pstabT1 + (1|ID), data = gifts) %>% display.lmer() %>% htable()
```

<br>

**Predicting Predicted Attitude Change**

We run this analysis only on participants who ultimately completed Time 2.

```{r}
gifts.both <- filter(gifts, retention == 1)
```

<br>

```{r}
lmer(pstabT1 ~ valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 +
       (1|ID), data = gifts.both) %>% display.lmer() %>% htable()
```

<br>

**Inferiority Test**

```{r}
# Code adapted from https://pedermisager.netlify.com/post/mixed_model_equivalence/

inf.model.S1 <- lmer(pstabT1 ~ valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + 
                    m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), data = gifts.both)

Study1.EmotT1.CIs <- contest1D(inf.model.S1, #Enters the above mixed model
          L = c(0,0,0,1,0,0), #Sets contrast to focus on EmotT1 effect
          rhs = -.05, #Sets lower bound to -.05
          confint = T, level = .9) %>% #Get 90% CIs
  mutate(p.onetail = `Pr(>|t|)`/2, #Convert two-tail test to one-tail
         p.value = ifelse(p.onetail < .001, "< .001", p.onetail)) %>%
  select(-`Pr(>|t|)`, -p.onetail) %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
htable(Study1.EmotT1.CIs) 
```

## Supplement: Separate Effects by Study

### Study 1A

```{r}
lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + 
       m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), 
     data = filter(gifts, study == "Study 1A")) %>% 
  display.lmer(CI = F) %>% htable()

lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + valence.eff*ExtT1 + valence.eff*EmotT1 + 
       m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), 
     data = filter(gifts, study == "Study 1A")) %>% 
  display.lmer(CI = F) %>% htable()
```

### Statistical Moderation by Study

**Main Effects**

```{r}
lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + study + valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + 
       m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + 
       (1|ID), data = gifts) %>%
    display.lmer() %>%  htable("center")
```


<br>

**Two-Way Interactions**

```{r}
lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + study*valence.eff + study*ExtT1 + 
       study*EmotT1 + 
       m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), data = gifts) %>%
    display.lmer() %>% filter(str_detect(term, "\\:")) %>% 
  htable("center")
```

<br>

**Three-Way Interactions**

```{r}
lmer(change ~ ValSwitch + study*valence.eff*ExtT1 + study*valence.eff*EmotT1 + 
        m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), data = gifts) %>%
    display.lmer() %>% filter(str_detect(term, "\\:valence.eff\\:")) %>% 
  htable("center")
```

## Predicting Valence Switching

```{r}
gifts <- gifts %>% 
  mutate(ValSwitch.F = factor(ValSwitch, 
                              labels = c("Same Valence", 
                                         "Switched Valence")))
```

<br>

**Study 1A:**

```{r}
glmer(ValSwitch.F ~ valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + 
        m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), 
      filter(gifts, study == "Study 1A"), family = "binomial",
      control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",
                           optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5))) %>% 
  display.glmer() %>% htable("center")
```

<br>

**Study 1B:**

```{r}
glmer(ValSwitch.F ~ valence.eff + ExtT1 + EmotT1 + m_ExtT1 + m_EmotT1 + (1|ID), 
      filter(gifts, study == "Study 1B"), family = "binomial",
      control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",
                           optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5))) %>% 
  display.glmer() %>% htable("center")
```
